description: Rename the element declared or referenced at a position, everywhere in the workspace. Returns the edits per document; writes the files only with apply=true.

apply.description: write every affected file, all or none, each replaced atomically (its mode is kept, other inode metadata is not); false (the default) only returns the edits

path.description: the document, absolute or relative to the workspace root

position.description: a position on the name to rename (1-based line and column)

name: rename

applied.description: whether the edits were written to disk

edits.description: edits to the document's current text, non-overlapping, in document order

newText.description: the text that replaces the range; empty deletes it

end.description: character after the span (1-based line and column)

start.description: first character of the span (1-based line and column)
